shared_file_rounds.limitation: Explicit round counts and elapsed wall time are observations, not CPU time, eliminated latency, or a causal end-to-end improvement. Epoch-start age excludes the later independent native query.

planning_output.limitation: Main plus sidecar payload bytes exclude IPC framing and other receipt metadata; worker-finish-to-join includes transport and event-loop scheduling, not isolated decode. The observed input factory includes native observation waits and freezing current planner inputs, not pure native-query or CPU time. Queue wait precedes capture on planner_turn_v1 and is not submitted-minus-detached. Ordinary detached-to-submit includes its lock wait and lazy pool creation. Events exist only after submission: cancelled pre-submission observers/waiters are not covered. No span subtraction yields measured serving performance.

limitations: Submit-to-receive includes socket delivery and receiver event-loop scheduling, not pure network time.
The GPU pending-to-acquired interval includes fresh HOST inventory and native core work, not pure IPC.
Bind has no separate request-level span. Engine-entry-to-queue is a containing envelope, not measured bind latency.
Arithmetic removals hold all other spans fixed; they are not causal bounds, an achievable policy, predictions, or publishable SLO.
No independent numerical adapter proof or repeated-run inference.
